entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕因你这般可怜卑贱（闽南语对应语句未能确解）
entries.en: because you are so wretched (Hokkien counterpart unresolved; tentative)
entries.notes: 闽南语对音 'quiam Bō nī / Būī nī'（謙卜年）与西语句义对应未解，R 栏空白，仅据 L 栏句义姑译，存疑。

entries.en: certainly, without a doubt (lit. 'no doubt')
entries.notes: 西语词头 'por fermo' 非通行拼法，缩写 ꝓn 未能展开；释义主要依闽南语 'Bô gūĩ'（莫＝无，gūĩ 疑类音）推定为'无疑'。

entries.zh: 为什么（带惊讶语气发问）
entries.en: why! (asked in astonishment)
entries.notes: 首字录作[疑:困/因]；闽南语 'ìn mȳ' 支持读作'因乜'（in-mih，何故），第二字'乜'或被误录为'也'。

entries.en: here; in this place
there; in that place
where?; by/in which place
for another matter/business; other things
entries.notes: '其他'为文言复合词，闽南语 'gūy tā̃'（guî-thânn）与其通行读法不尽相合，对应关系依推断。

entries.en: on the one hand; firstly, for one part
on the other hand; secondly, for the other part
for the sake of; out of regard for
entries.notes: 闽南语另录一读 'uy hô'，汉字栏无对应字符，未能解，姑以'带著（带著情分）'为主释义。

entries.zh: 彼此相带念；相互有情分
entries.en: attached to one another; mutual regard
to bear someone in mind; to regard with favor
to be considerate of; compassionate regard
for the sake of (someone); out of regard for

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕搀搭混合（西语词头读法未定）
entries.en: to mix in; blend (Spanish headword uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语词头 'por agraua ∼' 拼法不明（agravar/agruar 等读法皆可能），仅据闽南语'搭攬 tah-lām（搀和）'姑译，存疑。

entries.en: therefore; for that reason
the reason why; the cause

entries.zh: 所载；所装载之物（亦指所记载内容）
entries.en: what is carried/contained; what is recorded
entries.notes: 西语词头 'por el-' 截断不全，对应关系依汉字'所载'与闽南语 'sôu chàè' 推定。

entries.en: cause and basis; that which one relies on
entries.notes: 西语词头 'por el ∼' 不全（∼承上条），释义以汉字'因依'与闽南语 'īn ī' 为准。

entries.en: almost; nearly; by a narrow margin
entries.notes: 第二字录作[疑:险/乙]（原件'險'或'乙'待辨），闽南语 'hiâm hiâm' 支持作'險險'（险险）。

entries.en: narrowly escaped death; almost died
therefore; consequently
